text: MGA-New Park belongs in equal parts to the companies Reflektor and Corporesa, owned respectively by Joan and Enric Sanahuja Amat, sons and heirs of Jaime Sanahuja Junyent, founder of MGA in 1976.
short: MGA-New Park is owned by the Sanahuja family.

source.name: Crónica Global (El Español): El grupo de boleras y casinos MGA alcanza un beneficio récord de 15,7 millones en 2024
source.quote: Dichas entidades son propiedad respectiva de Joan y Enric Sanahuja Amat, hijos y herederos de Jaime Sanahuja Junyent, fundador de MGA en 1976.
source.note: English: those entities are respectively owned by Joan and Enric Sanahuja Amat, sons and heirs of Jaime Sanahuja Junyent, founder of MGA in 1976. The same report says the group manages two online casinos, in Spain and Portugal, and runs its gaming rooms under the Golden Park brand.
